notes:
Company background: SignalForge builds a SaaS knowledge-base and in-app help layer used by mid-market software vendors. Primary goal: replace a brittle hybrid of keyword search + manual heuristics with an embeddings + cross-encoder rerank pipeline to improve precision for support use cases. Key constraints: moderate index scale (target 2-6M canonical docs after dedupe), very high read QPS on peak (400-700 QPS), bursty traffic after product releases. Latency targets: P95 end-to-end for retrieval + rerank <200ms; ideal P50 <80ms. Cost sensitivity: needs unit-cost analysis; finance wants < $0.005 per query (embed+rerank amortized) for target SLA. Security: will evaluate hosted API but requires SOC2, SSO/SAML integration, audit logs, and a data residency option for EU customers. Team wants open-model compatibility (able to host open weights) and Redwood's automatic fallback/routing appealing for balancing cost vs quality.

Call notes / quotes:
- "We need answers that actually surface the right KB article, not the 3rd result that mentions the word. Reranker is critical." - Head of Product
- "If we can keep cost predictable while meeting latency, we can consolidate vendors." - VP Finance
- "POC needs to simulate peak QPS for a week; can we get guidance on batching configs and KV cache settings?" - Senior ML Engineer

Integration / POC details:
- Ingest: incremental pipeline from Zendesk exports + Google Drive, dedupe by fingerprinting. Estimated index after normalization ~3.2M docs.
- Search pipeline: approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) recall layer -> lightweight filter -> cross-encoder rerank on top-k=30.
- Metrics to validate: MRR @10, click-through on suggestions, P95 latency, cost per 1k queries.

Open items:

- Confirm whether hosted API can provide customer-scoped KMS for keys or if enterprise private is required.
- Pricing for rerank-heavy workloads (we expect ~3-4x token cost vs embed-only flows).
